# mondoo_integration_okta (Resource)

Okta integration. Create it in a Mondoo organization (`org_id`), whose asset routing rules place the assets into spaces, or in a space (`space_id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "credential_mrn" {
  description = "The Okta CredentialMrn"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}
variable "organization" {
  description = "The Okta Organization"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}
variable "token" {
  description = "The Okta Token"
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

# Set up the Okta integration
resource "mondoo_integration_okta" "example" {
  name           = "Okta Integration"
  credential_mrn = var.credential_mrn
  organization   = var.organization
  token          = var.token
}
```

```terraform
# Create the integration in the Mondoo organization instead of a space. The API
# creates no routing rule: the organization's asset routing rules place the
# assets it discovers into spaces.

variable "okta_token" {
  description = "The Okta API token"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "mondoo" {}

resource "mondoo_integration_okta" "organization" {
  org_id       = "your-org-1234567"
  name         = "Okta Integration"
  organization = "acme.okta.com"
  token        = var.okta_token
}

# Route every asset of this integration into one space
resource "mondoo_asset_routing_rule" "okta" {
  org_mrn          = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/organizations/your-org-1234567"
  target_space_mrn = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456"
  priority         = 10

  condition {
    field    = "LABEL"
    operator = "EQUAL"
    key      = "mondoo.com/integration-mrn"
    values   = [mondoo_integration_okta.organization.mrn]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the integration.

### Optional

- `credential_mrn` (String) The Okta CredentialMrn
- `org_id` (String) Mondoo organization identifier. Set this to create the integration in the organization. Conflicts with `space_id`.
- `organization` (String) The Okta Organization
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If neither `space_id` nor `org_id` is set, the provider space is used.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The Okta Token

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
terraform import mondoo_integration_okta.example "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
